queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS eligible_rows,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cancelled AND qty > 0 THEN qty * pence ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled AND qty < 0 THEN -qty * pence ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancellation_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(qty * pence), 0) AS net_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cancelled AND qty > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold FROM inspected WHERE price > 0 AND qty IS NOT NULL AND ((NOT cancelled AND qty > 0) OR (cancelled AND qty < 0)) AND invoice IS NOT NULL AND invoice <> '' AND occurred IS NOT NULL AND occurred >= ? AND occurred < ? AND COALESCE(product, '(missing)') = ?

SELECT CAST(occurred AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS eligible_rows,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cancelled AND qty > 0 THEN qty * pence ELSE 0 END), 0) AS gross_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled AND qty < 0 THEN -qty * pence ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancellation_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(qty * pence), 0) AS net_pence,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT cancelled AND qty > 0 THEN qty ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold FROM inspected WHERE price > 0 AND qty IS NOT NULL AND ((NOT cancelled AND qty > 0) OR (cancelled AND qty < 0)) AND invoice IS NOT NULL AND invoice <> '' AND occurred IS NOT NULL AND occurred >= ? AND occurred < ? AND COALESCE(product, '(missing)') = ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "source_InvoiceNo", "source_StockCode", "source_Description", "source_Quantity", "source_InvoiceDate", "source_UnitPrice", "source_CustomerID", "source_Country", qty * pence AS signed_pence FROM inspected WHERE price > 0 AND qty IS NOT NULL AND ((NOT cancelled AND qty > 0) OR (cancelled AND qty < 0)) AND invoice IS NOT NULL AND invoice <> '' AND occurred IS NOT NULL AND occurred >= ? AND occurred < ? AND COALESCE(product, '(missing)') = ? ORDER BY occurred, "source_InvoiceNo", "source_StockCode", "source_Description", "source_Quantity", "source_InvoiceDate", "source_UnitPrice", "source_CustomerID", "source_Country" NULLS FIRST LIMIT ?

periods.preparation_sql:
CREATE TEMP VIEW inspected AS SELECT raw."InvoiceNo" AS "source_InvoiceNo", raw."StockCode" AS "source_StockCode", raw."Description" AS "source_Description", raw."Quantity" AS "source_Quantity", raw."InvoiceDate" AS "source_InvoiceDate", raw."UnitPrice" AS "source_UnitPrice", raw."CustomerID" AS "source_CustomerID", raw."Country" AS "source_Country",         trim(InvoiceNo) AS invoice, trim(StockCode) AS product,
        NULLIF(NULLIF(trim(CustomerID), ''), 'nan') AS customer,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(Country), ''), '(missing)') AS country,
        CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(Quantity), '[+-]?[0-9]+([.]0+)?')
             THEN try_cast(Quantity AS BIGINT) ELSE NULL END AS qty,
        CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(UnitPrice), '[+-]?[0-9]+([.][0-9]{1,4})?')
             THEN try_cast(UnitPrice AS DECIMAL(18,4)) ELSE NULL END AS price,
        round(try_cast(UnitPrice AS DECIMAL(18,4)) * 100)::BIGINT AS pence,
        coalesce(try_cast(InvoiceDate AS TIMESTAMP),
                 try_strptime(InvoiceDate, '%m/%d/%Y %H:%M')) AS occurred,
        starts_with(upper(trim(InvoiceNo)), 'C') AS cancelled FROM raw

warnings: Eligible source entries explain the recorded accounting change, not its cause or business impact.
The sample is the first matching rows in deterministic order, not a random or representative sample. Duplicates are retained.
Samples include only lines eligible under the metric contract; they are not the full raw-data quality report.
Descriptions are recorded source text, not verified product classifications. An absent period is not proof of no business activity.
Daily rows cover observed eligible dates; unlisted dates are not imputed observations.

queries.sql: SELECT COALESCE(product, '(missing)') AS segment, COALESCE(SUM(qty * pence), 0) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM lines WHERE price > 0 AND qty IS NOT NULL AND ((NOT cancelled AND qty > 0) OR (cancelled AND qty < 0)) AND invoice IS NOT NULL AND invoice <> '' AND occurred IS NOT NULL AND occurred >= ? AND occurred < ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY segment

SELECT COALESCE(product, '(missing)') AS segment, COALESCE(SUM(qty * pence), 0) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM lines WHERE price > 0 AND qty IS NOT NULL AND ((NOT cancelled AND qty > 0) OR (cancelled AND qty < 0)) AND invoice IS NOT NULL AND invoice <> '' AND occurred IS NOT NULL AND occurred >= ? AND occurred < ? GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY segment

warnings: Contributions are accounting changes, not causal drivers, forecasts, or profit.
Newly/no-longer observed means eligible records in these windows; it does not establish acquisition or churn.
Ranking uses absolute change. Displayed rows plus the explicit remainder equal the overall change.
Source duplicates and eligibility rules are unchanged. Missing source activity is not proof of no business activity.
Stock codes can represent fees and adjustments as well as merchandise; inspect source descriptions before interpreting a product-code change.
